checked_scope: The full-information dominant-action tail theorem and the external-regret counterexample.
checks: Conditional score-difference range length two gives Hoeffding MGF exp(θ²/2); optimizing at θ=Δ yields date-t error ≤K exp(−Δ²(t−1)/2), including ties without temporal independence.

Summing over all dates after m gives the geometric infinite-tail bound. On its complement each empirical marginal has inferior-action mass ≤m/t, and dominance bounds product exploitability by that mass simultaneously at every t.

The coordination joint history pays one, gives nonpositive external-regret differences, and has product payoff 5/8 versus deviation payoff 3/4, giving exploitability 1/8. Finite-window inference uses independent groups and does not itself certify unobserved tail dates.
